representativeTask.title: Implement a function spec with pinned Aider through Zeck
representativeTask.description: Run the pinned Aider coding assistant (upstream 5dc9490bb35f9729ef2c95d00a19ccd30c26339c) on a representative corpus task (implement-function). Aider operates with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model call (main completion, weak-model commit messages, chat summarization) becomes a real Zeck execution through the public API; the task result (the implemented function, verified by the corpus check script) and the full Zeck execution trace (lifecycle, route, verification, usage) are exposed.

runBinding.runtime: compat/aider (bun run compat/aider/harness/run-battery.ts composes the pinned Aider runtime, the Zeck adapter, the egress-deny proof environment and the in-process Zeck execution plane)

reproducibility.instructions: From the Zeck repository root: (1) install pinned Aider verbatim: python3 -m venv /home/z/my-project/.venv-aider && /home/z/my-project/.venv-aider/bin/pip install -e /path/to/aider@5dc9490bb35f9729ef2c95d00a19ccd30c26339c; (2) run the battery: bun run compat/aider/harness/run-battery.ts — it composes the Zeck public API in-process, serves the OpenAI-compatible Zeck adapter on a loopback port, runs pinned Aider over the 5-task corpus under the scrubbed environment and the default-deny egress proxy, and writes deploy/evidence/ppr-018.json with every execution's Zeck trace. The model supply is the sandbox's authorized GLM endpoint (platform-side BYOK material at /etc/.z-ai-config).
